title: The lost photograph of the Bolden band
summary: Dr. Bichet had her picture of the whole band with Willie at the slide and Buddy Bolden; she never got it back and the interviewers hope to find a copy.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: Hunting for old band photographs and scrapbooks

blocks.x: Did you say Dr. Bichet had five pictures of yours or just that one?
No, it was the picture of Willie.

Yeah, the band. That's what it was, and I didn't want to get rid of it. It had Willie. Willie was standing over the slide, and Buddy Bowden, and all of them. But I didn't get it back, and I often wondered what to come up. And I went down there, and we hunted, we hunted. Nobody knowed him. Mm-hmm. But I had that dress, you understand?
Yeah, it was right there, 1400 St. Bernard.

Well, he wasn't there no more. I ain't know the man died until you told me. Well, that's what happened. Yeah, I said that to you. Oh, and it wasn't good. He saw it. It was good, wasn't it? Yes. Yeah. I was gonna have it in, uh, large, you know, from that. Then I was gonna get a frame, you understand? And put it in the frame. I said, well, I'd keep that. I'd say, maybe someday somebody may come along, and they would want that, and it might be something to them, you know? And so many people done asked me for that little picture. Yeah.
Well, we'll check it and see if we can't find a copy of it.

I wish to God I could get it. I sure wish I could get it, because it was a good picture. He saw it, because it was the one I showed it to. Yeah, you was the one I showed it to, because it's not recognized.
Yeah, I have a copy in that book. Yeah, it is. I know I'd find it.
Let me see what I did after all these times. Lord, all that time.
Well, that's a good picture, too. It's a good picture of him.
Real clear. He wasn't, he didn't weigh 260 pounds then, though, did he?
